# ProtectedShare

> Encrypt a note, a .env file, or a one-time secret in the browser, then share a link. No account required.

The public site is https://protectedshare.me. The source is https://github.com/KunalSiyag/protectedshare (MIT). Contact: admin@protectedshare.me.

## Tools

- [Secure Notes](https://protectedshare.me/notes): AES-256-GCM in the browser. The link can open the note, or the password can be copied separately. Expiry is 1 hour, 1 day, 7 days, or a custom time up to 30 days. Burn after reading is optional.
- [EnvShare](https://protectedshare.me/secrets): share a .env file or API key. The password stays in the URL hash. Choose 1 to 100 reads. Same expiry window as notes.
- [Encrypted Notepad](https://protectedshare.me/notepad): markdown vault. Local mode stays in the browser. Cloud mode uploads ciphertext.
- [Anonymous Chatroom](https://protectedshare.me/chat): room id plus password. Messages are ciphertext.
- [Self-host](https://protectedshare.me/self-host): Next.js web app plus a Cloudflare Worker and D1.

## What the server stores

Ciphertext, IV, and salt, plus a password proof used to authorize a read. The proof is not the decryption key. The URL hash is not sent to the server.

- [Privnote](https://protectedshare.me/vs/privnote)
